body: {"better": "A", "reason": "Card A is warmer and more natural—'కలిసి కారులో వెళ్దాం' flows as one friendly invitation, while B splits it awkwardly. A's 'మీరు అక్కడ ప్రశాంతంగా నడవొచ్చు' gives a concrete, personal reason (peaceful walking) tied to the trail; B's 'అందమైన ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలు' is generic and slightly stiff. A also uses మీరు correctly and naturally; B's final 'మీరు' is grammatically odd ('మీరు ఇంటికి వచ్చేయొచ్చు' sounds like she comes alone). Both keep venue names and use no English, but A's tone is more like a neighbor's daughter talking to an elder."}
